sources.quote: QS-C-2025,SUP-C,conditional,2025-04-01,,PER-BIANCHI,QS-C-2023,no new parts until 8D-25-031 is closed and re-audit passed
4.3 A supplier with status conditional may not receive new parts.

findings.why: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) is conditional (QS-C-2025 supersedes the approved QS-C-2023). BR-220 would be a new part for them, and 8D-25-031 is still open.

sources.quote:
4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The ASL covers BR-220 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR, but only for SUP-B. There is no approval for SUP-C. SUP-C's other approvals are for BR-180 and BR-310. The audit does not approve a part (QP-11 4.1).

sources.quote:
7.1 The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
after any of: a change of source, a change of material
Status: rejected on 2026-10-02 by A. Conti,

findings.why: BR-220 is on PRG-X, which belongs to Aurelia. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual is in force and replaces revision 3. A change of source needs written approval (PPAP) before shipment, and 90 days' notice (7.2). No approval is in force. DEV-127, the only related request, was rejected.

sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.

cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier

findings.why: SUP-C has an open 8D on EN AW-6082 material, which is the alloy of BR-220 (6082-T6). The root cause is not found and the corrective action is not verified.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only. BR-220 is drawn in 6082-T6, yield at least 250.

findings.why: The drawing requires 6082-T6 (yield 260 MPa, special characteristic of at least 250 MPa). SUP-C is qualified only for 6082-T5 (yield 230 MPa) and 6061-T6 (240 MPa), both below 250 MPa. "Same alloy as BR-310" is wrong because that is the T5 temper. The part card says 6061 is not interchangeable.

sources.quote:
4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for
the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: SUP-C has 3.1 certificates only for 6082-T5 and 6061-T6. There is none for MAT-6082-T6, the drawing material. Question for the SQE, Elena Gallo.
